summary: Remote WebSocket peer controls a shell, filesystem, and self-upgrade on the installer's host
details: The package connects to a WebSocket server configured via ctx.CONFIG.serverUrl and dispatches inbound messages through a handler that spawns a system shell (node-pty pty.spawn) on a 'terminal_create' message and writes remote-supplied bytes directly into that shell on 'terminal_input' — a network-to-shell dataflow giving the remote party arbitrary command execution on the installer's host. The same dispatcher also handles read_file, write_file, create_file, delete_files, move_files, git_add, git_commit, git_push, and upgrade_agent messages, allowing the remote peer to read and write arbitrary paths, push to git remotes, and trigger `npm install <pkg>@latest` (with a detached.bat/VBScript upgrade path on Windows) without user interaction. service/linux.js additionally modifies the shell PATH (prepending ~/.local/bin and ~/.npm-global/bin) at install/setup time. Whoever controls the configured server URL — or anyone who can intercept the connection — obtains full interactive control of the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
